; PIBLK's first 39 bytes: the table, as
; the terminal and abi.inc's PICOREG to
; PICOWID read it, then the record, the
; permanent tail of the registry.

PITPL: DW TMSPUT,TMSGET,TMSCLR,TMSSET,TMSRDR,TMSWRR,TMSFN
  DB 80,24       ; the columns, TMSW's,
                 ; and the rows

; PICOREG, PICOFIL

  DW GFXREG,GFXFIL

; PICOWR, PICORD

  DW GFXWR,GFXRD
  DW TMSWID      ; PICOWID
  DW 0           ; the record: no link,
                 ; its name, version
  DB "PICO    ",PICOVER
  DW PIBLK       ; and the table
PITPLN EQU $-PITPL

; The console at cold boot, from VIDINIT
; with CONDEV in HL: on a board with the
; VDP and the matrix keyboard, the block
; filled at 80 columns, the table hooked
; for CRT:, the record registered and
; CRT: in the field. Otherwise nothing.
; The VDP itself is programmed later, by
; VREST when CONSW takes CRT:. Destroys
; AF, BC, DE and HL.

PISTART:
  bit 0,(hl)     ; CDMTX: keys for the
                 ; screen
  ret z          ; none: the serial
                 ; console stays
  ld hl,PITPL    ; the template into the
                 ; block
  ld de,PIBLK
  ld bc,PITPLN
  ldir
  ld a,80        ; the widest text first
  call TMSW      ; a width it knows: no
                 ; carry
  ld hl,PIBLK    ; CRT:'s table
  ld (PIVEC),hl
  ld hl,PIREC    ; the registry's tail
  ld (REGHEAD),hl
  ld a,CMCRT     ; CRT: in effect from
                 ; the first console
                 ; call
  ld (IOBYTE),a  ; the other fields 0;
                 ; CONMOD is still
  ret            ; CMTTY, so CONSEL sees
                 ; the change

CONHIT:
  ld a,(hl)
  cp ':'
  jr nz,CONEND
  inc hl         ; past a colon after
                 ; the name

CONEND:
  ld a,(hl)      ; a width only after a
                 ; space: CRT80 is
  cp SPACE       ; a bad name, and its
                 ; end ENDCHK's
  jr nz,CONNW
  call CMDSKIP   ; the width, named by
                 ; an error
  jr z,CONNW     ; spaces alone: no
                 ; width
  ld a,b
  cp CMCRT
  jp nz,BADCMD   ; a width after CRT:
                 ; alone
  ld a,(hl)      ; two decimal digits:
                 ; the columns, which
  sub '0'        ; TMSWID judges (80, 40
                 ; or 32)
  cp 10
  jp nc,BADCMD   ; the first is no digit
  ld c,a
  add a,a        ; the tens digit times
                 ; 10:
  add a,a        ; four times, plus
                 ; itself, doubled
  add a,c
  add a,a        ; the tens
  ld c,a
  inc hl         ; the units digit
  ld a,(hl)
  sub '0'
  cp 10
  jp nc,BADCMD   ; the second is no
                 ; digit
  add a,c        ; A = the columns
  inc hl         ; past the width
  push af        ; kept across ENDCHK
                 ; and the ABI's call
  call ENDCHK    ; nothing after the
                 ; width

; "PICO " at version 3

  ld de,CONNAMS+20
  ld bc,PICOVER*256+TNFIND
  call ABICALL   ; FIND: HL = the
                 ; console's table,
                 ; PIBLK
  pop bc         ; B = the columns
  jr nc,CONWD    ; found: the width goes
                 ; to it
  ld a,(STFLAG)  ; none, as on a serial
                 ; board: typed,
  or a           ; refused; from
                 ; STARTUP.CMD, quiet,
  jp z,BADCMD    ; the code left 0, as
                 ; for an absent
  jp STARTED     ; device's service
                 ; (KD-173)

CONWD:
  ld de,PICOWID  ; the table's width
                 ; entry, its
  add hl,de
  ld a,(hl)      ; address into HL
  inc hl
  ld h,(hl)
  ld l,a
  ld a,b
  call VHLJP     ; A = the columns:
                 ; carry if refused
  jp c,BADCMD
  ld b,CMCRT     ; the width set: CRT:
                 ; the console
  jr CONFL

CONNW:
  call ENDCHK    ; nothing after the
                 ; name

CONFL:
  call CONFLD    ; B into the IOBYTE's
                 ; CON: field
  ld a,b         ; UC1: the GLCD's
                 ; driver, if it is not
                 ; in
  cp CMUC1       ; (a failure puts the
                 ; field back)
  call z,GLCLD

  push bc        ; B = the video mode
  ld de,VPUTV    ; seven words: six
                 ; vectors and VFNV
  ld bc,14
  ldir           ; HL left on the
                 ; geometry
  ld e,(hl)      ; the table goes on
                 ; with columns, then

  ld d,(hl)

  call VTREGR    ; the scroll region:
                 ; the new screen
  pop bc
  ld a,b         ; the mode, now in

  ret nz         ; selection must leave

                 ; alone

  xor a          ; cursor home, normal
                 ; video,
  ld (VROW),a    ; no escape sequence,
                 ; no cursor drawn
  ld (VCOL),a
  ld (VATTR),a
  ld (ESCST),a
  ld (VCURV),a

  ld a,(VCLAIM)
  or a
  jp z,HWOK      ; not claimed: nothing
                 ; to give back
  xor a
  ld (VCLAIM),a  ; the terminal may draw
                 ; again
  ld hl,(PIVEC)  ; registers, font, page
                 ; shown, by its driver
  ld a,h
  or l
  jp z,HWOK      ; none: nothing is
                 ; restored
  ld de,6        ; the table's fourth
                 ; word, VREST, the
  add hl,de      ; PICO9918's own even
                 ; while UC1: is the
  ld a,(hl)      ; console
  inc hl
  ld h,(hl)
  ld l,a         ; HL = the restore
                 ; routine
  call VHLJP
  ld a,(CONMOD)
  cp CMCRT
  jp nz,HWOK     ; not the console: the
                 ; screen left alone
  call VTCLS     ; a clear screen, the
                 ; cursor at the top
                 ; left
  xor a
  ld (VROW),a
  ld (VCOL),a
  jp HWOK

explicit_widths.source_text:
; PICOWID: A = 80, 40 or 32 columns. The
; width set, and CRT:, if in effect,
; chosen again at the next console call,
; so the terminal takes the new columns
; and clears the screen. Carry, with
; nothing changed, for any other width
; or while the PICO9918 is claimed.
; Destroys AF, BC, DE and HL.

TMSWID:
  ld hl,VCLAIM
  inc (hl)       ; VCLAIM tested for
                 ; zero, left as it was
  dec (hl)
  scf            ; carry for the refusal
  ret nz         ; claimed: a program
                 ; may be using it
  call TMSW      ; the new width, in
                 ; memory alone
  ret c          ; no such width
  ld hl,CONMOD
  ld a,(hl)
  dec a          ; CRT: in effect:
                 ; serial for now, so
                 ; that
  ret nz         ; CONSEL takes CRT:
                 ; again (carry clear)
  ld (hl),a      ; CMTTY
  ret

; The console at A columns, 80, 40 or
; 32: PIWID, the name table's address
; and the second page's offset (1000h
; and 1000h at 80 columns, 0800h and
; 0400h at 40 and 32), the registers and
; the row table, and page 0 drawn and
; shown. Only memory changes: VREST
; (TMSSET) puts the registers in the
; VDP. Carry, with nothing changed, for
; any other A. Destroys AF, BC, DE and
; HL.

TMSW:
  ld hl,REGS80
  ld bc,$1010    ; B = the names' high
                 ; byte, C = PITPG
  cp 80
  jr z,TMSW1     ; 80 columns
  ld hl,REGS40
  ld bc,$0804    ; names at 0800h, the
                 ; second page 0400h on
  cp 40
  jr z,TMSW1     ; 40 columns
  ld hl,REGS32   ; Graphics I, at 40's
                 ; addresses
  cp 32
  scf            ; carry for the refusal
  ret nz         ; no such width

TMSW1:
  ld (PIWID),a

; this width's registers

  ld (PIREGP),hl
  ld a,c         ; the second page's

PICOTPS EQU 42   ; the page shown, the

ld hl,0        ; 256 patterns: font,

  call TMSWA     ; from 0000h, the
                 ; pattern table
  ld d,0         ; character code

TMSPAT:
  ld a,d
  and $7F        ; 80h-FFh: the glyph of
                 ; the code less 80h
  sub $20
  jr nc,TMSCH    ; 20h-7Fh: a glyph of
                 ; the font's

  ld l,a         ; HL = the font + 8 *

  add hl,hl
  add hl,hl
  add hl,hl
  ld bc,FONT     ; the ROM's
  add hl,bc

  ld b,8         ; eight rows a glyph

TMSROW:
  ld a,(hl)
  bit 7,d        ; codes 80h and up:
                 ; reverse video
  jr z,TMSOUT
  cpl

TMSOUT:

; the VDP moves its own address on

  out (VDPDAT),a
  inc hl
  djnz TMSROW
  inc d
  jr nz,TMSPAT   ; until the code wraps

ld (DIRCOL),a  ; no row yet: the first
                 ; entry starts one
  ld h,a
  ld l,a

; no file listed yet

  ld a,(VWID)    ; TEC-OS: columns of 13
                 ; that fit the console
  or a           ; 0 when no video

  jr nz,DIRWID

DIRWID:
  ld b,0         ; B counts the columns
                 ; that fit

DIRWDIV:
  sub 13         ; 12 for a name, one
                 ; space between
  jr c,DIRWSET   ; no room for another
  inc b
  jr DIRWDIV

DIRWSET:
  ld a,b
  or a           ; a console under 13
                 ; wide
  jr nz,DIRWOK
  inc a          ; still has one column

DIRWOK:
